note: Fail-closed per-gate cardinality contracts for packs/a2a-durability-pack.
Keyed by GATE STEM (gates/NNN_stem.rq -> "stem"), not filename.
Every contract is PREDICATE-anchored: the anchor's own blind spot (total loss of the
anchor predicate) is exactly what the companion verify/*.unbound.rq queries name, so
contract + companion have disjoint blind spots.
"surfaces" is anchored on dur:truthPath (a required conjunct), not the subject IRI.
"capabilities" emits one row per dur:hasCapability edge, so VALUES on the edge predicate.
"court_citations" emits one row per dur:citesCourt edge, so VALUES on the edge predicate.
